current_state.zh: Next Technology Holding's board authorized the分批 sale or collateralization of its ~5,833 BTC (~$449M), citing exchange vulnerabilities including the Binance attack and quantum-computing risks to Bitcoin, with CEO Weihong Liu to decide timing, pricing and size.
